name: AcDisplayAs
description: Use with the DisplayAs property to specify what is displayed in an Attachment control.

constants.name: acDisplayAsImageIcon
constants.description: If the attachment is a supported image format, then the image is displayed. If the attachment is not a supported image format, then the icon for that file type is displayed.

constants.name: acDisplayAsIcon
constants.description: The attachment is displayed as the icon for that file type.
